name: Five Nights at Treasure Island: The Revenge
summary:
Treasure Island… Isn't over.
There's still one thing that's not finished; A contract. Will you escape? Will you accept your fate? Will you drown in despair? Or will you discover a secret so horrible to bear? Donna has some unfinished business in Treasure Island, a location she previously frequented that has been taken over by a corporation known as SEA (Supernatural Entertainment Association, Formerly; SSA). They have turned the island into a Horror attraction. To unwrap her past, and face her future, Donna started working at the island. Little does she know there's more to everything than she thought at first. A contract? Evil Spirits? What could be going on? Find out in Five Nights at Treasure Island: The Revenge.
“20 Years have passed since we are waiting for revenge”.

“Five Nights at Treasure Island: The revenge” is an Unofficial spin-off to the original game made by AnArt1996.
